title: Nature Gui Pack
description: This Is Gui But With Alittle Bit Of Nature in the Inventory
body:
A clean and immersive Natural GUI Pack designed to give Minecraft a softer, more organic look while keeping the vanilla feeling intact.
This pack redesigns the GUI with natural colors, smooth textures, and a cozy aesthetic that fits perfectly with survival, exploration, and fantasy-style gameplay.

Features:
• Redesigned inventory and interface textures
• Natural color palette with smooth details
• Vanilla-friendly style
• Clean and simple look without overcomplicating the UI
• Works great with shaders and texture packs

Perfect for players who want a fresh interface while still keeping the original Minecraft atmosphere.
